overview.headline: Lincoln proclamation made freedom a Union war aim

keyPoints.point: Northern war aim at first was to prevent secession and preserve Union
keyPoints.quote: was fought by the North to prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union

keyPoints.point: Preliminary warning stated enslaved people in states still in rebellion would be declared free
keyPoints.quote: which stated that enslaved people in those states or parts of states still in rebellion as of January 1, 1863, would be declared free

keyPoints.point: Proclamation limits left slavery untouched in loyal border states and seceded areas under Union control
keyPoints.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states

keyPoints.point: Proclamation announced acceptance of Black men into Union Army and Navy to expand freedom
keyPoints.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy
